01  ·  WHY NOW  ·  為什麼是現在
Three Policy Currents and One Scientific Shift Converge
三條政策線與一條學術線交會
1
Ageing and Long-term Care 2.0
高齡化與長照 2.0
Non-pharmacological demand is growing fast; the health system needs affordable, scalable options.
非藥物介入需求擴大，醫療體系尋找可負擔、可規模化的方案。
2
Rural Regeneration 2.0
農村再生 2.0
Green-care demonstration schemes mean rural sites need service models grounded in evidence.
綠色照顧示範計畫推動，農村場域需要有實證基礎的服務模型。
3
Precision Health Talent
精準健康人才培育
Ministry of Education cross-disciplinary programmes link health to agriculture and environment.
教育部跨領域計畫，將健康與農業、環境專業接軌。
4
A Scientific Shift
研究典範轉移
From correlation to causal and dose-response evidence — which needs precise measurement and controlled settings.
從相關性走向因果與劑量反應，需要精準量測與可控環境。
The center sits exactly where the four currents cross — the college's field sites, the horticultural and forestry expertise, and the health-technology toolkit.
中心正好座落在這四條線的交點：農學院的場域、園藝與森林的專業、健康科技的工具，缺一不可。

slides.title: Three Missions in the Center's Charter
slides.text:
01  ·  WHY NOW  ·  為什麼是現在
Three Missions in the Center's Charter
中心三大任務
1
Research and Industry Collaboration
參與農業療癒與健康環境研究計畫
Take part in university, inter-university and government research and industry projects on agricultural therapy and healthy environments, and turn the results into social service — the university's social responsibility in practice.
積極參與校內、校際、政府推動之農業療癒與健康環境之學術研究或產學合作相關計畫，並將研究成果轉為社會服務，實踐大學社會責任。
2
Talent Cultivation
培育農業療癒與健康環境專長人才
Build curricula and creative teaching that bring students into government programmes and social needs, raising their awareness of policy and their ability to take part in it and deliver.
結合課程設計，運用創意教學帶領學生參與政府相關計畫並支援社會需求，提升學生對政策之關注、參與和執行能力，培養農業療癒與健康環境領域人才。
3
International Platform
建立農業療癒與健康環境國際平台
Act as an integrating hub, widening the network of scholars, professionals and organisations at home and abroad for joint research and shared agendas.
整合資源合作核心，擴大連結農業療癒與健康環境相關領域之學者、專業人士及國內外組織，進行研究合作及議題探討。
The Landscape and Human Health platform is already running, with joint conferences held; its eight member universities are listed in section 06.
已建立 Landscape and Human Health 國際合作研究平台，合作交流並舉辦國際研討會（八校成員名單見第 06 章）。

Lab 302 — Healing Environment Planning Lab

ENVI-met microclimate simulation
ENVI-met 微氣候模擬
Built on fluid dynamics and thermodynamics, it simulates the interaction of ground, buildings, planting and air. The digital model covers building tiers, tree canopy, grass, sidewalk, asphalt and water, and is calibrated with WatchDog weather stations and a TR-31B radiant-heat sensor.
基於流體動力學與熱力學，模擬地表、建築、植栽與空氣之交互作用；數位模型涵蓋建築分層、樹冠、草地、人行道、柏油與水體，並以 WatchDog 環境感測站與 TR-31B 熱輻射量測儀校正。
One model yields both human thermal comfort and building cooling load
Health benefit and energy use are solved in the same set of physical equations — the technical basis on which green health and smart energy are integrated, and the interface that couples micro-scale physiology upward to regional models.
同一套模型，同時算出熱舒適度與建築冷卻負荷；健康效益與能源消耗在同一組物理方程式中求解。
